summary: Iteration 3 covers new QUALITY_ASSESSOR + LOGISTICS_PROVIDER roles, anonymous market ticker, voice call overlay and RBAC on the two new dashboards. Backend: 14/14 tests pass in test_krishisetu_v3.py (market ticker + filter, all 6 seed logins, quality dashboard/queue/attest/history with farmer 403, logistics dashboard/queue/status-update with buyer+farmer 403, legacy /api/dashboard regression, ownership fix for GET /api/v1/lots/:id — buyer without offer now returns 403, AI chat regression). Frontend: landing shows KS logo + hero tagline/subtagline + market ticker with DEMO DATA label; login shows all 6 quick-login buttons; farmer flow (role badge, voice call overlay open/hangup, chat→voice switch, logout); quality flow (dashboard + stats + qa-open + qa-attest + quality-flash + /app/sell forbidden); logistics flow (dashboard + stats + advance + logistics-flash); buyer /app/sell forbidden; nav counts match (farmer 4, quality 2, logistics 2, admin 5). Only failure: ADMIN visiting /app/quality and /app/logistics crashes with a runtime error.

ui_bugs.issue: When an ADMIN visits /app/quality or /app/logistics, the components call GET /api/v1/dashboard which returns the admin dashboard shape (no `assessor` / no `provider` object), then blindly read `data.assessor.name` / `data.provider.name` and throw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')`. The Emergent Runtime Error overlay appears and the page is blank. Spec explicitly requires: 'Admin can visit /app/quality and /app/logistics and see the same dashboards (Protected allows ADMIN)'.

action_items: Fix admin cross-view of Quality/Logistics dashboards. Two options: (a) in QualityDashboard.jsx / LogisticsDashboard.jsx, guard with optional chaining `data.assessor?.name || 'Admin'` and `data.provider?.name || 'Admin'`, and skip queue/shipments header for admin; OR (b) in Node backend routes/dashboard.js, when role === 'ADMIN' and Referer/route hint requests quality/logistics dashboard, return the same shape (`assessor`/`provider` synthesised with name='Admin' + full stats+queue+shipments). Recommend (a) since /api/v1/dashboard is role-based; frontend needs to fetch queue/history directly for admins (call /api/v1/quality/queue and /api/v1/logistics/queue) or hide those sections when data.assessor/provider missing.
critical_code_review_comments: QualityDashboard.jsx and LogisticsDashboard.jsx assume the role-scoped payload without a shape guard; both crash on any dashboard response that omits `assessor`/`provider`. Add null-safety and role-aware data loading.

Quality/Logistics sidebar nav labels differ from the review-request wording (Attestation queue / All lots vs. observed nav-overview + nav-quality). Functional but consider aligning testids/labels with spec for clarity.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 6 roles verified via quick-login and /api/v1/auth/login.
seed_data_creation: Created one Potato/30q Grade B lot for Rajesh (for ownership-403 regression). Reused existing seeded LOT-2409-0001 + freshcart demand to create/advance a shipment via offer-accept flow (needed by logistics status update test). Test attestation notes 'TEST attestation' written on first queue lot. No cleanup — persists in Postgres.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_krishisetu_v3.py is a self-contained regression for the iteration-3 additions. All 14 tests green. The one open bug is FE-only: admin cross-visit to /app/quality and /app/logistics throws a runtime error because the shared /api/v1/dashboard endpoint returns the admin shape without assessor/provider. Everything else — including RBAC 403 for farmer on quality/logistics endpoints, buyer+farmer 403 on logistics/shipments/:id/status, ownership 403 on GET /api/v1/lots/:id for buyer without offer — is fixed and covered.
rca of the issue: Frontend components QualityDashboard.jsx:33 (`{data.assessor.name}`) and LogisticsDashboard.jsx:30 (`{data.provider.name}`) dereference a role-specific field from the shared /api/v1/dashboard response. Node backend routes/dashboard.js branches by req.user.role, so an ADMIN request receives the admin shape (users/lots/offers/txCount) without any `assessor` or `provider` object. Reproduction: quick-login as admin@krishisetu.dev → navigate to /app/quality (or /app/logistics) → Emergent runtime error overlay with message 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading name)'. Mitigation: use optional chaining and a role check in the two dashboards, or expose /api/v1/quality/dashboard + /api/v1/logistics/dashboard endpoints callable by ADMIN that always return the assessor/provider-shaped payload.
